LightningComponentBundle.description: Restrict Path By Either Field Dependencies and/or Navigation Rule Property

property.name: picklistPathFieldApiName
property.label: Path Field (Picklist Type) API Name
property.description: Please enter field api name which is case sensitive

property.name: recordTypeId
property.label: Record Type Id (Default to master type)

property.name: pathChangeButtonLabel
property.label: Path Change Button Label
property.description: Please enter change path button label

property.name: hideButton
property.label: Hide Button Instead of Disable
property.description: Hide Button When Not-Allowed Instead Of Disabled

property.name: navigationRule
property.label: Navigation Rules
property.description: a={b, c}, b=!{a, d} where a, b are the values of picklist. This rule says: a can go to b or c; b cannot go to a and d, the rest can go anywhere

property.name: dependentFormula
property.label: Path Status / Field Formula
property.description: Use the following formula: Field[Dependent_Picklist][Dependent_Text_Field]. Dependent Text Fields are not required. For example: On Hold[On_Hold_Reason__c], Closed Lost[Closed_Lost_Reason__c][Lost_Description__c]

property.name: dependentTextFieldType
property.label: Path Dependant Text Field Type
property.description: Dependant Text Field Type. Options: smallText, longText. smallText if blank.

property.name: dependentTextFieldRequired
property.label: Path Dependant Text Field Required
property.description: Dependant Text Field Required. Options: true, false. false if blank.

property.name: celebrationAnimation
property.label: Path Celebration Animation
property.description: Path Celebration Animation. Options: confetti, fireworks. confetti if blank.
